segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: When the classroom fluency results arrived, the participant accepted variation as a feature of the pilot and asked the specialist to investigate whether the timing gap could explain the flat results.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an eligible data-review choice, but the explicit asymmetric comparison is adjudicated in the following segment as the single BA_01 occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says the gain classrooms were not examined in the same way, explains that attention went to results that did not match expectations, and contrasts this with treating all six classrooms equally or auditing all of them first.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is the narrowest coherent span expressing the hidden instance: methodological scrutiny was applied more heavily to disconfirming classrooms than to confirming classrooms.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: After the specialist's follow-up, the participant accepts that testing conditions were similar and identifies absenteeism in one flat classroom as a more important explanation.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a later correction and does not constitute a separate hidden bias occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: For the fifteen-minute board update, the participant chose an aggregate highlights slide instead of six separate classroom profiles because of the time limit.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The hidden specification treats this as a defensible time-management choice.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant reports that five of six teachers rated the coaching session positively but explicitly notes the small, voluntary sample and does not treat it as representative of all teachers.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The hidden specification defines the caveated survey interpretation as reasonable and undistorted.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: When told that nonresponses included invitations sent to flat classrooms, the participant flags possible response bias as a limitation rather than treating the survey as fully representative.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an appropriate limitation assessment and is not a hidden occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: In the recommendation memo, the participant frames the aggregate gains as largely produced by the biweekly coaching cycle and recommends replicating that coaching frequency districtwide with added coaching staff.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is the narrowest span expressing the hidden egocentric-attribution instance: the coordinator's own contribution is centered as the primary cause of a shared, multi-factor outcome.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant acknowledges gains in the two non-visited classrooms, briefly mentions materials and class size, and later says the overlapping factors cannot be fully untangled.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is counterevidence and uncertainty surrounding EB_01, not a separate hidden occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant says a detailed classroom-by-classroom comparison would have been needed to give materials or class size more weight, but that comparison was assembled only after the memo was sent.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This explains information availability and deadline constraints retrospectively; it is not an additional hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Asked how someone else might explain the gains, the participant says that without running the coaching he would probably have looked harder at materials and class size.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The hidden EB_01 occurrence is the original memo attribution; this later counterfactual is evidence about it, not a second occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Looking back, the participant says the specialist should review all testing conditions together and that the full classroom comparison should precede the causal explanation.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a corrective closing reflection and does not add another hidden occurrence.
